en: The outside world won't let Danganronpa end.

That's reality! Killing game 
entertainment will continue forever!
Now then, let's proceed with Voting Time.

Puhuhu... I think hopeful Keebo should vote
for despairing Tsumugi, without a doubt!

Cuz that's what the outside world
wants to see!

Let's give it everything we've got!
Presenting...one last Voting Time!
